AcceptDataworksEvent.title: AcceptDataworksEvent
AcceptDataworksEvent.summary: PAI accepts and processes system event messages from DataWorks.

AddImage.title: Add image
AddImage.summary: Adds a custom image to a workspace.

AddImageLabels.title: AddImageLabels
AddImageLabels.summary: Adds labels to a specified image.

AddMemberRole.title: AddMemberRole
AddMemberRole.summary: Assigns a role to a member in a workspace, granting that member the role's permissions.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: ChangeResourceGroup
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Changes the resource group of a specified resource.

CreateCodeSource.title: Create code configuration
CreateCodeSource.summary: Creates a code configuration in PAI. You can configure a Git code branch and CommitId. After the configuration is created, it can be referenced in DLC jobs.

CreateConnection.title: CreateConnection
CreateConnection.summary: Creates a connection to link PAI cloud services with your models, databases, and other services. This is useful for scenarios such as LangStudio and multimodal dataset retrieval.

CreateDatasetFileMetas.title: CreateDatasetFileMetas
CreateDatasetFileMetas.summary: Creates file metadata records for a dataset in a batch.

CreateDatasetVersionLabels.title: CreateDatasetVersionLabels
CreateDatasetVersionLabels.summary: Creates labels for a dataset version.

CreateImageBuild.title: CreateImageBuild
CreateImageBuild.summary: Builds a custom image based on the specified configuration. After the image is successfully built, it is added to the list of custom images in the current workspace.

CreateMember.title: CreateMember
CreateMember.summary: Adds one or more users to a workspace.

CreateModel.title: CreateModel
CreateModel.summary: Creates a model, which is a collection of model versions. You must specify information such as the model name and description.

CreateModelVersion.title: CreateModelVersion
CreateModelVersion.summary: Adds a new version to a specified model.

CreateModelVersionLabels.title: CreateModelVersionLabels
CreateModelVersionLabels.summary: Creates labels for a model version.

CreateProductOrders.title: CreateProductOrders
CreateProductOrders.summary: Purchases products. This operation supports pay-as-you-go purchases of DataWorks, OSS, PAI, and MaxCompute.

CreateRun.title: Create a run
CreateRun.summary: Creates a run. A run belongs to an experiment and can be associated with a specific workload or can be a standalone code execution.

CreateWorkspaceResource.title: CreateWorkspaceResource
CreateWorkspaceResource.summary: Add a resource reference to a workspace.

DeleteCodeSource.title: DeleteCodeSource
DeleteCodeSource.summary: Deletes a code source configuration by its ID.

DeleteDatasetFileMetas.title: DeleteDatasetFileMetas
DeleteDatasetFileMetas.summary: Deletes file metadata records from a dataset in batches.

DeleteDatasetVersion.title: DeleteDatasetVersion
DeleteDatasetVersion.summary: Deletes a specified version of a dataset. This operation cannot be used to delete version v1. Version v1 is deleted with the dataset when you call the DeleteDataset operation.

DeleteDatasetVersionLabels.title: DeleteDatasetVersionLabels
DeleteDatasetVersionLabels.summary: Deletes labels from a dataset version.

DeleteExperimentLabel.title: DeleteExperimentLabel
DeleteExperimentLabel.summary: Deletes a label from an experiment.

DeleteModelVersionLabels.title: DeleteModelVersionLabels
DeleteModelVersionLabels.summary: Deletes labels from a model version.

DeleteRunLabel.title: DeleteRunLabel
DeleteRunLabel.summary: Deletes a label from a run.

DeleteWorkspace.title: DeleteWorkspace
DeleteWorkspace.summary: Deletes a workspace. This operation does not release associated resources. You must release them manually.

DeleteWorkspaceResource.title: DeleteWorkspaceResource
DeleteWorkspaceResource.summary: Detaches a resource from a workspace. This operation does not delete the underlying resource.

DeleteWorkspaceRoles.title: DeleteWorkspaceRoles
DeleteWorkspaceRoles.summary: Deletes one or more roles from a workspace.

GetCodeSource.title: Get code source configuration
GetCodeSource.summary: Retrieves the details of a code source configuration.

GetConnection.title: GetConnection
GetConnection.summary: Retrieves the details of a connection.

GetDatasetFileMeta.title: GetDatasetFileMeta
GetDatasetFileMeta.summary: Retrieves the metadata record of a specified file in a dataset.

GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics.title: GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics
GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics.summary: Retrieves statistics for metadata in a dataset.

GetDatasetJobConfig.title: GetDatasetJobConfig
GetDatasetJobConfig.summary: Retrieves the configuration of a dataset job.

GetDatasetVersion.title: GetDatasetVersion
GetDatasetVersion.summary: Retrieves information about a specific dataset version.

GetDefaultWorkspace.title: GetDefaultWorkspace
GetDefaultWorkspace.summary: Retrieves the details of the default workspace.

GetImage.title: GetImage
GetImage.summary: Retrieves the details of an image.

GetInstanceJob.title: GetInstanceJob
GetInstanceJob.summary: Gets the details of a job.

GetMember.title: GetMember
GetMember.summary: Retrieves a member of a workspace.

GetModel.title: GetModel
GetModel.summary: Gets the details of a specified model.

GetPermission.title: Retrieve workspace permissions
GetPermission.summary: Retrieves the permissions of a workspace.

GetWorkspace.title: GetWorkspace
GetWorkspace.summary: Retrieves the details of a workspace.

GetWorkspaceRole.title: GetWorkspaceRole
GetWorkspaceRole.summary: Gets information about a specific role within a workspace.

ListCodeSources.title: List code configurations
ListCodeSources.summary: Queries a list of code configurations. This operation supports pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering.

ListConfigs.title: List workspace configurations
ListConfigs.summary: Retrieves the list of workspace configurations.

ListDatasetFileMetas.title: List dataset file metadata
ListDatasetFileMetas.summary: Queries the list of dataset files.

ListDatasetJobConfigs.title: ListDatasetJobConfigs
ListDatasetJobConfigs.summary: Lists dataset job configurations in batches.

ListDatasetJobs.title: Get dataset task list
ListDatasetJobs.summary: Retrieves a list of dataset tasks.

ListDatasetVersions.title: ListDatasetVersions
ListDatasetVersions.summary: Retrieves a list of dataset versions.

ListDatasets.title: ListDatasets
ListDatasets.summary: Lists the datasets in a workspace.

ListImageLabels.title: ListImageLabels
ListImageLabels.summary: Queries a list of image labels.

ListModelVersions.title: ListModelVersions
ListModelVersions.summary: Retrieves a list of model versions.

ListPermissions.title: ListPermissions
ListPermissions.summary: Retrieves a list of user permissions in a workspace.

ListQuotas.title: ListQuotas
ListQuotas.summary: Retrieves a list of resource quotas.

ListResources.title: ListResources
ListResources.summary: Lists resources associated with a workspace.

ListRunMetrics.title: ListRunMetrics
ListRunMetrics.summary: Retrieves a list of metric records for a run.

ListWorkspaceRoles.title: ListWorkspaceRoles
ListWorkspaceRoles.summary: Lists the roles in a specified workspace.

ListWorkspaceUsers.title: List users that can be added to a workspace
ListWorkspaceUsers.summary: Lists users who have not joined a workspace and can be added as workspace members.

ListWorkspaces.title: List workspaces
ListWorkspaces.summary: Retrieves the list of workspaces in a specified region.

LogRunMetrics.title: LogRunMetrics
LogRunMetrics.summary: Records the metrics of a run in a batch.

PublishCodeSource.title: PublishCodeSource
PublishCodeSource.summary: Publishes a private code source, making it public in a workspace.

PublishDataset.title: PublishDataset
PublishDataset.summary: Publishes a private dataset in a workspace.

PublishImage.title: PublishImage
PublishImage.summary: Publishes an image and changes its visibility from PRIVATE to PUBLIC.

RemoveImageLabels.title: RemoveImageLabels
RemoveImageLabels.summary: Removes a label from an image.

RemoveMemberRole.title: RemoveMemberRole
RemoveMemberRole.summary: Removes a role from a member.

SetExperimentLabels.title: SetExperimentLabels
SetExperimentLabels.summary: Updates the labels of an experiment.

UpdateConfigs.title: Update or create workspace configurations in batches
UpdateConfigs.summary: Updates or creates workspace configurations in batches.

UpdateDataset.title: UpdateDataset
UpdateDataset.summary: Updates the properties of a dataset, such as its name and description.

UpdateDatasetFileMetas.title: UpdateDatasetFileMetas
UpdateDatasetFileMetas.summary: Updates multiple file metadata records in a dataset.

UpdateDatasetVersion.title: UpdateDatasetVersion
UpdateDatasetVersion.summary: Updates the information for a specific version of a dataset.

UpdateDefaultWorkspace.title: UpdateDefaultWorkspace
UpdateDefaultWorkspace.summary: Sets a workspace as the default.

UpdateModel.title: UpdateModel
UpdateModel.summary: Updates the basic configuration of a model.

UpdatePrompt.title: Update a prompt
UpdatePrompt.summary: Updates the prompt of a dataset.

UpdateRun.title: UpdateRun
UpdateRun.summary: Updates the details of a run.

UpdateWorkspace.title: UpdateWorkspace
UpdateWorkspace.summary: Updates the name and description of a workspace.

UpdateWorkspaceRole.title: UpdateWorkspaceRole
UpdateWorkspaceRole.summary: Updates a role in a workspace.
